package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TagRepoPG implements TagRepository.
type TagRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts tag.
func (r TagRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, tag domain.Tag) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO tag (name, slug, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING`,
		tag.Name, tag.Slug, tag.CreatedAt)
	return err
}

// GetByID finds tag by id.
func (r TagRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.Tag, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, name, slug, created_at FROM tag WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var t domain.Tag
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Name, &t.Slug, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// GetBySlug finds tag by slug.
func (r TagRepoPG) GetBySlug(ctx context.Context, slug string) (*domain.Tag, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, name, slug, created_at FROM tag WHERE slug=$1`, slug)
	var t domain.Tag
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Name, &t.Slug, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// Update updates tag fields.
func (r TagRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, tag domain.Tag) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE tag SET name=$1, slug=$2 WHERE id=$3`, tag.Name, tag.Slug, tag.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete removes tag by id.
func (r TagRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM tag WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns tags with pagination.
func (r TagRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TagFilters) ([]domain.Tag, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	whereClause := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		whereClause = "WHERE (COALESCE(name,'') ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OR COALESCE(slug,'') ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + ")"
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) FROM tag " + whereClause
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	query := "SELECT id, name, slug, created_at FROM tag " + whereClause + " ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OFFSET $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var tags []domain.Tag
	for rows.Next() {
		var t domain.Tag
		if err := rows.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Name, &t.Slug, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		tags = append(tags, t)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return tags, total, nil
}

var _ repository.TagRepository = (*TagRepoPG)(nil)
